name: Cometary-Quoin
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the east, an orbital debris ring. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
the signal of unknown origin bends the local reality in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
There is money in aluminum, platinum, titanium and iron and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
